{{Top|leg}}
The '''Tribe of Issori''' was one of the two houses that comprised the [[Issori-Odenji government]]. Members of the organization were elected by their representative [[Species/Legends|species]] and served for the duration of their natural lives. The laws enacted by the bi-cameral legislature&mdash;the other half being the [[Tribe of Odenji]]&mdash;were enacted throughout the [[Trulalis system]].<ref name="AE">''[[Alien Encounters]]''</ref>
